q: In a multiple access channel (MAC) with two senders, the capacity region is:
opts: A pentagon characterized by conditions R₁ ≤ I(X₁;Y|X₂), R₂ ≤ I(X₂;Y|X₁), R₁+R₂ ≤ I(X₁,X₂;Y)
A square R₁ ≤ C₁, R₂ ≤ C₂
exp: The MAC capacity region is a convex pentagon bounded by three mutual information constraints. Superposition coding and successive cancellation decoding achieve the corner points of this region.
